_comment: Copy to <run>/deliverables/claim_narratives.jsonl and author ONE RECORD PER CENTRAL CLAIM. Lines whose keys all start with _ are comments and are skipped.
Facets, in render order: observed_result, authors_interpretation, reviewer_inference, contradiction, evidence_gap. Every facet is {"text": ..., "evidence_ids": [...]}.

THE RULE: a statement must EITHER cite evidence_ids that exist in evidence/evidence.jsonl, OR set "inference": true, in which case it renders under an explicit reviewer-inference label in both deliverables. A statement with neither is a contract violation and build_review.py and build_pdf.py both refuse to render — the reader must always be able to tell observation from interpretation from inference.

An uncited contradiction must also set "no_qualifying_anchor": true. That records a searched-but-empty outcome instead of making an unsupported reported finding look retained. Otherwise omit the facet.

observed_result states WHAT WAS MEASURED and is anchored by the claim's verbatim quote; it is not the authors' reading of it. authors_interpretation is what the paper concludes. reviewer_inference is yours and is never presented as a source statement. contradiction carries the countervailing result or the alternative explanation the data also permits. evidence_gap says what no retrieved paper answers.
Omit a facet you have nothing to say for; do not invent one. The file itself is optional — a run without it renders as a plain quote-under-claim report.

observed_result.text: Plasma Z fell 38% from baseline over 12 weeks in treated animals and was unchanged in vehicle controls (Fig. 2B).

authors_interpretation.text: The authors read the fall as direct target engagement rather than a downstream consequence of reduced disease burden.

reviewer_inference.text: The vehicle arm drifted by less than one standard deviation over the same window, so regression to the mean is an unlikely explanation of the treated-arm fall — but no retrieved paper tests that directly.

contradiction.text: A second cohort in the same study showed no change in plasma Z at the lower dose, so the effect is dose-dependent rather than general.

evidence_gap.text: No human study in the corpus reports plasma Z after treatment; every anchor above is rodent.

observed_result.text: REPLACE with the measured result, in the units the paper reports it in.

authors_interpretation.text: REPLACE with what the authors conclude from that result.

reviewer_inference.text: REPLACE with your own reading, which no source states.

contradiction.text: REPLACE with the countervailing result or the alternative explanation the data permits.

evidence_gap.text: REPLACE with what no retrieved paper answers.
